script.problem: There are 6 moments. There are 1 to 5.

terra.problem: The line implies that all of Israel’s story takes place in Canaan. Much of it also takes place elsewhere; say that Canaan is where much of Israel’s story takes place.

“Twelve Spies Sent Out” happens in the Wilderness of Paran, not in Canaan. Also, Numbers 13:1–3 does not include Moses’ instructions to examine the land and bring back fruit; those are in verses 17–20.
“The Spies’ Report” is given at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Paran, not in Canaan. The gathering of fruit happens in Canaan, but the return and report happen elsewhere.

“Manna Stops in Canaan” can imply that the Israelites began eating Canaan’s crops the day the manna stopped, though they had already eaten the land’s produce the day before. Joshua 5:12 says they ate Canaan’s crops that year.
